title: Newly annexed areas
text:
20.22.060 Newly annexed areas.
A.	Nonconforming rights may be granted to uses or structures located within newly annexed areas in accordance with the following provisions. An application for registration and certificate of occupancy for the nonconforming use or structure must be filed with the building official.
B.	Incomplete Construction. Construction may be completed on any structure legally under construction upon annexation provided:
1.	The owner or his designated representative applies to the city for a building permit to authorize further work on the structure stating the proposed use of the structure and attaching thereto the plans and specifications relating to the construction; and
2.	The construction is completed within one hundred twenty days of the effective date of the issuance of the building permit unless an extension is granted.
(Ord. 16653 § 2 (part), 2007)
(Ord. No. 17442, § 52, 10-26-2010)
